summary: security checked in 1 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Risk severity is high for public exposure and medium for bounded changes adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: retain all private launch gates, continue only bounded read-only evidence capture and existing containment/measurement work, and permit ordinary reversible growth only when existing consent, disclosures, claims, provenance, and release controls are preserved. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify configuration, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or claim certification.
